observations: Tile has optional GlobalPos and StructureTemplate serialization, but bindScroll only reads scroll data, stores position and looks up the target level, then ends without constructing/updating template or a gameplay result. Missing data lacks null protection; absent load keys leave reused fields unchanged.

Block use path is server-only but newBlockEntity explicitly returns null; concrete block and tile registrations are both commented out at pinned BlockRegistry389–390. Thus serialization methods alone are insufficient evidence of an actually available implementation.

ITickable default tick is empty and class does not override it; renderer simply delegates super and has no restored template gameplay consumer. Bound local text search found only this unfinished block/tile and commented registration plus render declarations.

This rejection is limited to pinned ScryerPlanarium chain; other Ars registered Planarium and projector implementations are not declared unfinished or rejected. Not evidence that all Ars persistence is invalid.
